assertions.why: the vendored skill file must exist
every description must stay <=200 chars or the skill picker truncates it
doctor detectVendorPin recognises vendoring by the Source and Pinned commit lines; the graft must not remove them
Apache-2.0 terms must stay next to the vendored skill

assertions.needle: EXCEPT the Forge-added parts marked "Forge addendum"
assertions.why: Apache-2.0 section 4(b): modified files carry a notice of the change
the doctrine must be reached before Phase 4 updates, through a pointer with a trigger
Forge additions stay marked so the upstream body remains identifiable

assertions.needle: After user approval, apply changes using the Edit tool. Preserve existing content structure.
assertions.why: the vendored body stays verbatim; a sample upstream sentence must still be there
the pointer target must exist (no false pointer)
daymade graft: an @import loads in full at start and saves no context

assertions.needle: never the goal of a change and never a result in the report
assertions.why: daymade graft: line count is a symptom, never a KPI
daymade Python scripts and python recipes are excluded; Forge checks run in Node
provenance table for the graft (repo, path, SHA, licence, taken, excluded)
